accessor_contract.constructor: 0x602ea50, called with the object address after a successful guard acquire
accessor_contract.guard_byte: 0x6500248 (BSS, zero at load = not yet initialized)

guard_calls.acquire_zero: another initializer owns the object; the init step is skipped

lookup.pair: first at stack +0x08, second at stack +0x10

accessor_contract.note: only the accessor's own control flow and call shapes are pinned; what value the lookup/convert pair produces is the accessor's output and enters the refresh model as an input
accessor_contract.retry_rule: the lookup repeats until the pair's first element is non-null; there is no separate retry cap in the accessor body

algorithm: Call the registry accessor with the stack temp as the output slot.

If the destination pointer equals the destination's own +0x58 address (short form) and the produced pointer equals the temp's own +0x10 address (short form), copy the produced bytes into the destination buffer.
If the destination is short-form and the produced value is heap, move the produced buffer into the destination and reset the temp to empty short form.
If the destination is heap and the produced value is short-form, copy the produced bytes into the destination's heap buffer.
If both are heap, move the produced buffer into the destination and free the old heap buffer with (old pointer, old capacity + 1), unless the old pointer is null.
Return with no value; the destination string now holds the accessor's output.

assignment_rules.heap_produced: move: the destination takes the produced pointer, size and capacity; the produced temp is reset to empty short form (pointer = its own +0x10 address, size 0, first buffer byte 0) and no buffer is freed for it
assignment_rules.nul_stores: the NUL stores at the old heap pointer and at the produced temp pointer happen immediately before the corresponding free or return and have no post-return effect; they are recorded as observed stores, not as state effects
assignment_rules.old_value: on the move path only, a previous heap destination buffer is freed with the sized delete passing (old pointer, old capacity + 1); a previous short-form destination buffer is inline and frees nothing; a null previous pointer frees nothing
preconditions: the destination is a live string (pointer non-null, or short-form)
the produced value is a live string from the accessor
the destination buffer and the produced temp buffer do not overlap
assignment_rules.short_form_limit: a short-form produced value holds at most 15 bytes, so copying it into any live destination buffer is in bounds
assignment_rules.short_produced: copy: the produced bytes are copied into the destination's existing buffer, the destination size becomes the produced size, a NUL byte is stored at destination pointer + produced size, and the destination keeps its own pointer and capacity
assignment_rules.string_layout: pointer +0x00, size +0x08, capacity-or-inline-buffer +0x10 relative to the string object; short form when the pointer equals the string's own +0x10 address
assignment_rules.temp_destruction_on_copy_path: after a copy, the produced temp is destroyed in place: size set to 0, a NUL byte stored at its pointer + 0, and, since it is short-form, no buffer freed

census.method: executable-LOAD-segment exhaustive E8/E9 scan with objdump confirmation, reproduced by census.py and re-run inside verify.py

consumers.caller_beyond_call: not pinned: the caller continues with a holder +0x1790 list walk and, later, the RB insert-position search 0x5d4e260 (covered by open PR #2619); what the caller does with the refreshed +0x48 string is not claimed here

observations: The accessor's second argument is never read: the refresh routine loads holder +0x318 into rsi, but every accessor-body use of rsi is a value it set itself (the pair addresses and the convert arguments). The load's source-level purpose is not pinned.
The accessor's guard byte and object live in BSS, so both are zero at load: the first call initializes the object, later calls skip initialization.

The refresh routine's copy loop is an inlined byte copy with 1-byte, 2-byte, 4-byte and 8-byte paths plus a qword loop; the model reproduces its effect (copy produced size bytes), not its path selection.
The routine never writes holder +0x318, holder +0x48's neighboring fields, or any field other than the destination string's own three slots.
The leading endbr64 in each routine is a genuine control-flow-integrity landing instruction present in the target binary, not a placeholder.

arguments.holder_plus_0x318: value loaded into rsi before the accessor call; the accessor body never reads its second argument (see observations)
